summary: B&G Foods filed an 8-K disclosing mutual termination, effective October 5, 2026, of its asset purchase agreement to sell the Green Giant and Le Sieur frozen and shelf-stable vegetable lines in Canada to Nortera Foods. Canadian Competition Act approval was not obtained by the September 24, 2026 outside date, so closing conditions failed. Under the contract, Nortera pays B&G US$1.6 million as a termination fee plus partial legal-expense reimbursement. B&G retains and will operate Green Giant Canada, with Nortera continuing as primary co-manufacturer; B&G still evaluates strategic alternatives, including a possible sale.
